models.name: Uncertainty spans and distributions
models.notes:
A Michaelis Menten rate law whose parameters are measured quantities. Every measurement is recorded with the distrib package: what was measured, how well it is known and where the number comes from.

The file writes every shape the package allows. An uncertainty which is a span carries its two ends as numbers (the range of Km, the confidence interval of the substrate) or as references to parameters of the model (the confidence interval of Km in the lysate, which names Km_lower and Km_upper). An uncertainty which is a single value carries it as a number or, for the mean of Vmax, as a reference to the parameter Vmax_mean, with the units it is measured in. A distribution carries the parameters it is defined by as uncert parameters of its own, and the rate carries the distribution as math.

The parameter Km carries two uncertainties, one per publication, because measurements from different sources belong into different uncertainties, and the notes of each of them say where its numbers come from. An uncertainty is not restricted to a parameter: the substrate carries one and so does the assignment rule of the rate.

The value the parameter of the model is set to.

uncertParameters.name: Beta distribution
uncertParameters.xml:
<distrib:uncertParameter distrib:id="Vmax_distribution" distrib:name="Beta distribution" distrib:type="distribution" distrib:definitionURL="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beta_distribution">
  <distrib:listOfUncertParameters>
    <distrib:uncertParameter distrib:id="Vmax_alpha" distrib:name="alpha" distrib:value="2" distrib:type="externalParameter" distrib:definitionURL="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beta_distribution#alpha"/>
    <distrib:uncertParameter distrib:id="Vmax_beta" distrib:name="beta" distrib:value="5" distrib:type="externalParameter" distrib:definitionURL="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beta_distribution#beta"/>
  </distrib:listOfUncertParameters>
</distrib:uncertParameter>
